chunks: From him, from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Sama'ah, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about the woman who has been thrice divorced according to the Sunnah, does she have residence (housing) or maintenance (nafaqah)? He said: No.
ai.seo_question: Does a husband have to provide housing and maintenance for a wife after a triple divorce?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies that a triple divorce (talqat thalathan) renders the husband exempt from providing housing (sukna) and maintenance (nafaqah) during the waiting period (iddah). This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it distinguishes the financial obligations in a final, irrevocable divorce from those in revocable divorces, emphasizing the immediate severance of ties.
